card.text: Explore Himalia, a moon of Jupiter, through its source-backed size model.

introduction.text: Himalia is Jupiter’s largest irregular moon. This approximate ellipsoid uses Cassini’s observed elongation with assumed equal short axes and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Outline approximation
model.summary: Approximate elongated shape using Cassini’s observed 1.25:1 outline and JPL’s size estimate. Equal short axes and the viewing orientation are assumed. The gray grid marks unmapped terrain.
